brief: 7 tools that turn one engineer into a team. Names, urls, why each matters.

slots.title: 2. Vercel, the platform engineer
slots.body: Vercel ships every commit to a global edge network (vercel.com). It handles CI/CD, previews, and scaling so you skip hiring a DevOps engineer.

slots.title: 3. Supabase, the backend engineer
slots.body: Supabase gives you Postgres, auth, and edge functions in one platform (supabase.com). It replaces a backend team and scales without ops overhead.

slots.title: 4. GitHub, the code reviewer
slots.body: GitHub hosts code, runs CI checks, and manages pull requests with built-in review (github.com). It acts as your entire engineering workflow layer.

slots.title: 5. Linear, the project manager
slots.body: Linear turns bugs and features into a clean roadmap with automatic cycles (linear.app). It replaces a product manager keeping the ship on track.

slots.title: 6. Stripe, the billing engineer
slots.body: Stripe handles subscriptions, invoicing, and tax compliance out of the box (stripe.com). It replaces a finance engineer building billing from scratch.

slots.title: 7. Zapier, the integrations engineer
slots.body: Zapier connects your stack and automates workflows across 5,000+ apps (zapier.com). It replaces an integrations engineer writing endless glue code.
